digest.component_or_area: outbound link-apply loop in rebar reconciler
propositions: Cancelled ACLI link-delete commands (exit non-zero due to stdin=DEVNULL prompt read) are incorrectly counted as applied links, reporting links_applied=N when zero links were removed.

The except CalledProcessError arm in _update_one_dispatch_links increments links_applied without distinguishing idempotent failures (404/409) from deterministic cancellations, and has no logging so failures remain invisible.

The deterministic cause is missing --yes flag on 'acli workitem link delete' and 'acli workitem link create' subcommands, which prompt for confirmation by default (same bug as documented in bug 3256 for workitem delete).
The silent-divergence canary REBAR_RECONCILER_FAIL_SILENT_NOOP cannot detect this defect because it checks computed>0 and applied==0, but the miscounting inflates applied to equal computed.

A new links_failed counter must be added to track failures separately from applied links, with idempotent detection narrowed to legitimate markers (404/409/does-not-exist/not-found case-insensitive on either stderr or stdout), so non-idempotent failures increment links_failed instead of links_applied.
